The supermarket is one of the best places in the city. Last Wednesday, Owen and Leo went to the supermarket. The weather was snowy that day. What's more, fish live in water.
Both of them like chicken and milk. Owen is going to travel to London in January. Owen and Leo had great fun there. Best of all, to be honest, I forgot the tickets.
Owen wrote about the day in the diary. Owen plays badminton with Leo every Wednesday. It takes twenty minutes to get to the supermarket by bike. The storm will weaken as it moves inland.
Owen borrowed a book about history from the cinema. Life is full of small surprises. There are always many people at the cashier.
